title: Document toolbar
why: A toolbar is a row of small decisions each of which has a component: the filters are Chips, the icon actions are IconButtons that MUST carry both an aria-label and a Tooltip, and the overflow is a Dropdown with its keyboard and portal already solved. Its bad fixture is the only one in the set that invents a component and drops a required prop, so `components-exist` and `props-complete` are proven to still fire.
